summary: AXIOM v5.1 retest after fixes — ALL THREE regression items PASS. (1) MANUAL tab now renders inline ADD MANUAL PLAY card with four inputs (manual-form-ticker/entry/score/risk) + [+ ADD PLAY] button (manual-form-submit) — verified visible on /lottery → MANUAL tab. (2) Full add-then-settle flow exercised live: typed TESTUI/4.20/70/50 → click [+ ADD PLAY] → row manual-TESTUI appeared in ACTIVE MANUAL PLAYS, form cleared. Clicked SETTLE on the row → inline editor (settle-input-TESTUI + settle-confirm-TESTUI + settle-cancel-TESTUI) appeared IN-ROW with NO browser prompt. Typed 6.50 → click OK → alert showed 'Realized P/L: 54.76%' (exact spec value). Row vanished from ACTIVE list, MANUAL TRACK RECORD counter incremented from 1 to 2 SETTLED. (3) Visited /contracts, /sec, /pharma — console scanned with capture_logs and pageerror handlers: ZERO 'unique key' React warnings on all three pages (down from 3+ in iteration_10). (4) Regression spot — /settings still renders INTEGRATION STATUS · 12, SCHEDULED JOBS · 7, TELEGRAM COMMANDS · 11. /performance still renders ACTIVE POSITIONS / CLOSED POSITIONS splits + OPTIONS PERFORMANCE chart. Zero page errors across the entire run. Lottery scan loading-state UI feedback was NOT specifically re-tested this iteration (not in fix scope per the request — flagged as integration polish item in iteration_10 but not blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: LotteryPage.jsx is now 439 lines — still under the 700-line threshold, but tab-branch rendering is getting dense. Consider extracting ManualTab into its own component if more features are added.

settle and add flows still use window.alert() to surface success/failure (lines 47, 75, 79). Non-blocking but inconsistent with the rest of the CRT panel design; consider an inline toast/banner row inside the Card.

The /contracts, /sec, /pharma key warnings are silenced via React.Fragment + stable composite keys — good fix. Recommend adding an eslint react/jsx-key rule in CI to catch future regressions automatically.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All v5.1 fixes verified live on https://stock-scout-bot.preview.emergentagent.com. data-testids confirmed working: manual-form-ticker, manual-form-entry, manual-form-score, manual-form-risk, manual-form-submit, manual-{ticker}, settle-{ticker}, settle-input-{ticker}, settle-confirm-{ticker}, settle-cancel-{ticker}. For future retests of the Settle flow, use a NEW ticker (TESTUI from this run is already settled and will be in the track record).
